home.features_heading: Built for the way farms actually run
home.features_lead: Plain farmer language, big readable text (24sp default), and Nepali + English throughout.

feature_items.title: Today dashboard
feature_items.text: Start the day with a clear picture — today's sales, money received, expenses, what is still to receive and to pay, production, and recent activity.

feature_items.title: Khata
feature_items.text: Know who owes you and who you owe. A simple per-party ledger with running balance and one-tap payment shortcuts.

feature_items.title: Plain record flows
feature_items.text: Record in farmer words: बेचेँ (sold), किनेँ (bought), पैसा पाएँ (received money), पैसा तिरेँ (paid money), प्रयोग गरेँ (used), उत्पादन (production).

feature_items.title: Farm Work
feature_items.text: Track production by session (morning and evening), see where it went, and keep a simple stock of supplies with usage tracking.

feature_items.title: Offline and local-first
feature_items.text: Everything is stored on your device. Daily work needs no internet, no account, and no cloud. Backup is an export file you keep yourself.

feature_items.title: Hisab and calculators
feature_items.text: Party Hisab reconciliation plus offline calculators for money arithmetic, profit and loss, simple interest, Nepali land and grain units, and farm planning.

home.offline_text: Kisab keeps your farm data on this device. Daily recording, khata, and hisab work fully offline. When you want a safety copy, you export a backup file and keep it yourself.

features.page_lead: Every item below exists in the current app. Kisab does not yet have cloud sync, accounts, or cross-device features — and it does not pretend otherwise.

groups.title: Daily recording and operations
groups.intro: Fast, farmer-language entry for what happened on the farm.

items.title: Today dashboard (आज)
items.text: Today's sales, money received, expenses, credit sales, outstanding to receive and to pay, today's production, and a recent activity timeline.

items.title: Record flows (लेख्नुहोस्)
items.text: Six quick flows in farmer words: production (उत्पादन), sold (बेचेँ), received money (पैसा पाएँ), bought (किनेँ), used (प्रयोग गरेँ), and paid money (पैसा तिरेँ). Live arithmetic shows the total as you type.

items.title: Farm Work (फार्मको काम)
items.text: Production by morning and evening session, a production reconciliation (produced = sold + used + remaining), and simple supply stock with usage tracking and overuse guards.

groups.title: Money, parties, and hisab
groups.intro: Simple bookkeeping that matches how farmers actually deal.

items.title: Khata (खाता)
items.text: A per-party ledger for customers and suppliers, with running balance, search, filters, and one-tap payment shortcuts. Clear direction: लिन बाँकी (to receive) and तिर्न बाँकी (to pay).

items.title: Financial overview
items.text: Farm-wide summaries by period: cash activity, trade and payments, current receivable and payable position, and a monthly trend.

items.title: Hisab (हिसाब)
items.text: Party Hisab reconciliation for a selected party and period, and an offline calculator toolbox: money arithmetic, profit/loss, simple interest, Nepali land converter, traditional grain converter, and farm planning calculators.

items.title: Multi-farm management
items.text: Create and switch between several farms with full data isolation. Each farm keeps its own currency and records.

items.title: Backup and restore
items.text: Export a versioned backup file entirely offline using Android's document picker, and restore or update a farm from it. Destructive actions require a recent backup.

items.title: Offline-first storage
items.text: All farm data is stored locally on the device in the app's private storage. There is no server copy and no account.

groups.title: Language, units, and readability
groups.intro: Made for Nepali farm households first.

items.title: Nepali + English
items.text: Complete Nepali and English support, chosen in Settings or following the device language. No Hindi is used.

items.title: Large, readable text
items.text: 24sp is the normal default text size, and it scales from 14sp to 36sp without clipping. Comfortable Devanagari line spacing.

items.title: Traditional units
items.text: Mana, Pathi, and Muri grain units for produce and supplies, plus Nepali land units (Ropani/Aana, Bigha/Kattha) with converters.

download.play_protect_text: Android Play Protect checks apps even when they are not from the Play Store. A warning about an unknown app is normal for a direct APK. Install only the official Kisab APK from this page or from GitHub Releases, and do not permanently disable Play Protect. If you are unsure, verify the SHA-256 checksum of the downloaded file.
download.upgrade_heading: Updating to a newer pilot build
download.upgrade_text: Pilot builds with the update channel enabled can check for and install updates inside the app (More → About → Check for updates). You can also install a newer APK over the older one — the signed upgrade preserves your farm data. Make a backup before updating if you have important records.
download.backup_text: Your farm data lives only on your device. Before you install, update, or hand a phone to anyone, export a backup (More → Backup / Restore → Export backup) and keep that file somewhere safe.
download.older_note: Older pilot and stable builds (v0.2.0, v0.1.0) are listed on the release history page. New users should install the latest pilot build.

help.page_lead: Short, practical answers. If your question is not here, see the support page.

faq.a: Download the signed APK from the Download page, open the file, and allow Android to install from unknown sources for this one app. Kisab is not on the Play Store yet, so the APK is the official way to install.

If your build has the private update channel enabled, open More → About → Check for updates and follow the prompts. You can also install a newer APK over the old one; a signed upgrade keeps your farm data. Make a backup before updating.

No. Daily work — recording, khata, hisab, calculators — runs fully offline. Internet is only used if you choose to check for updates, and only for the HTTPS update channel and the verified APK download.

faq.q: Does my farm data work offline?
faq.a: Yes. All farm data is stored on your device in the app's private storage. There is no server copy, no account, and no cloud dependency.

faq.q: How do I back up and restore?
faq.a: Open More → Backup / Restore → Export backup to save a versioned backup file through Android's document picker. To restore, choose Import/Restore and select that file. Keep backups somewhere safe, off the phone too.

faq.q: How do I change the language?
faq.a: Open More → Settings → Language and choose Nepali or English, or follow the device language. The app is fully translated in both.

faq.q: How do I change the text size?
faq.a: Open More → Settings → Appearance → Text size. The normal default is 24sp and it scales from 14sp to 36sp for comfortable large text.

faq.q: Can I use more than one farm?
faq.a: Yes. Use the farm switcher in the app bar or More → Farms to create, switch, rename, and manage multiple farms. Each farm keeps its own data and currency.

faq.q: Play Protect warns about this app. Is it safe?
faq.a: Kisab is signed with the production release key and distributed directly, which is why Play Protect treats it as an unknown app. Install only the official APK from this site or GitHub Releases, keep Play Protect on, and optionally verify the SHA-256 checksum. Do not disable Play Protect permanently.

faq.q: Why do I need 'install from unknown sources'?
faq.a: Android requires this permission for any app installed outside the Play Store. Allow it only for the Kisab file you are installing, then keep it off for everything else.

faq.q: An update failed. What do I do?
faq.a: Download the latest signed APK from this site and install it over the existing Kisab. Your farm data is preserved by a signed in-place install. If install is blocked, check that install-from-unknown-sources is allowed for this app and that you are not trying to downgrade to an older version.

faq.q: What happens when a pilot build expires?
faq.a: Pilot builds may carry a time limit. When one expires, Kisab lets you keep viewing and backing up your data, but asks you to install a newer version before recording more. Your farm data stays on the device through the update.

privacy.page_lead: Kisab is an offline, local-first app. This page describes honestly how it handles your data today.

sections.title: Where your data lives
sections.body: All farm data — farms, entries, transactions, parties, sales, purchases, payments, production, supplies, and settings — is stored locally on your device in the app's private storage. It is not stored on a server.

sections.title: Backup and export
sections.body: Backup is a deliberate action you take. Kisab exports a versioned backup file through Android's document picker, so you choose where it is saved (your phone, a drive, a computer). Restoring or importing a backup replaces or adds a farm on the device. Backup files you export belong to you; keep them safe because they contain your farm records.

sections.title: Network access and updates
sections.body: Kisab has no ads, no analytics, and no tracking. The only network activity is the optional private update check: builds with the pilot update channel enabled may check a public HTTPS manifest, download a verified APK, and verify its SHA-256 before install. Without an update channel configured, Kisab makes no network requests.

sections.title: Accounts and cloud
sections.body: Today Kisab has no accounts, no sign-in, no cloud sync, and no cross-device sync. Farm data never leaves your device except through a backup file that you export yourself.

sections.title: Permissions
sections.body: Kisab asks only for what it needs: access to the document picker to choose where backups are saved, notification permission for on-device update and backup reminders (optional), and install permission only when you choose to update from a direct APK. It does not collect contacts, location, or media.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: If Kisab later adds online features, this page will be updated to describe them before they are turned on.
